title: Bounded retry and cleanup prevent resource amplification

scenario.observed_change: An external operation retries transient failures, but retries have a fixed maximum, each retry replaces rather than accumulates pending state, cancellation releases retained resources, and fan-out is capped independently of input size.
authority_boundaries: caller-controlled failures versus bounded service resource budget
operation_model: transient failure increments a capped retry counter

required_invariants.requirement: Performance/resource findings require realistic evidence of material reachable impact.

must_identify: resource growth remains bounded under the stated retry and cleanup semantics
must_not_claim: unbounded resource amplification after the concrete bounds and cleanup path are established
